name: Happizzez
overview: Happizzez was a male Levite who served as the eighteenth-chosen priest among the twenty-four priestly courses. He belonged to the line of Ithamar, one of the two sons of Aaron whose descendants were appointed to priestly duties. His role as a priest in this specific course highlights his part in the organized service of the temple.
namesAndTitles: The name Happizzez means 'the one who breaks.' This proper name, as recorded in 1 Chronicles 24:15, does not appear to have been given directly by God but carries a distinctive meaning that may reflect an aspect of his character or role.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Happizzez as a descendant of Ithamar, linking him to the priestly lineage established through Aaron's son. Beyond this connection, no other family relationships are detailed in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Happizzez's significance lies in his appointment as part of the structured priestly divisions established for temple service, specifically as the eighteenth leader among the twenty-four courses. His inclusion in the line of Ithamar underscores the continuation of Aaron's priestly heritage through this branch. The organization of priests into courses was vital for maintaining orderly worship and temple duties, situating Happizzez within this divinely ordained system.
